info.name: Kibana APIs Actions Security Timeline API API

params.name: documentIds
params.description: Event document `_id` values to match against each note's `eventId`. When this parameter is present, the response is all matching notes (up to the server's hard limit), not a paged list using `page`/`perPage`.

params.name: savedObjectIds
params.description: Timeline `savedObjectId` value(s). Returns notes that reference those timelines. When present, list-mode pagination parameters are not used; up to the server's hard limit of notes may be returned.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for list mode (when `documentIds` and `savedObjectIds` are omitted). Passed as a string; default 1.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Page size for list mode (when `documentIds` and `savedObjectIds` are omitted). Passed as a string; default 10.

params.name: search
params.description: Search string for saved-objects find (list mode only).

params.name: sortField
params.description: Field to sort by for saved-objects find (list mode only).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order (`asc` or `desc`) for saved-objects find (list mode only).

params.name: filter
params.description: Kuery filter string combined with other list-mode filters (for example `createdByFilter` or `associatedFilter`). Typed as a string for API compatibility; interpreted by the saved-objects layer (list mode only).

params.name: createdByFilter
params.description: Kibana user profile **UID** (UUID). The server resolves the user's display identifiers and returns notes whose `createdBy` matches any of them (list mode only).

params.name: associatedFilter
params.description: Restricts notes by how they relate to a Timeline and/or an event document (list mode only). Some values apply extra filtering after the query. Ignored when `documentIds` or `savedObjectIds` is used.
